Finally, the technology plan must include a secure-storage configuration record documenting how the files will be protected in the restricted drive. I'd also note that these technology requirements align well with the privacy restrictions Mr. Lewis identified — keeping restricted recordings in the internal OralHistory drive rather than publishing them publicly should help ensure the five consent-excluded interviewees' recordings remain properly segregated.
